We ship one feature a month. That number is the whole philosophy.

When the team wants to build three things, the monthly limit forces the argument about which one actually matters, and that argument is where the product gets good. Last quarter we killed a calendar integration people had asked for, because support tickets showed the real problem was our reminder emails landing in spam. Fixing spam took a week and cut churn measurably. The calendar integration would have taken six weeks and hidden the real issue.

Slow shipping is not a constraint we tolerate. It is the mechanism.
